MERGE INTO ICOMCDDT A USING ( SELECT #V_CODE# AS CODE, #CODE_NO# AS CODE_NO, '100' AS HOUSE_CODE, 'KEPC' AS COMPANY_CODE, '1' AS USE_FLAG FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.CODE = B.CODE AND A.CODE_NO = B.CODE_NO AND A.HOUSE_CODE = B.HOUSE_CODE AND A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.USE_FLAG = B.USE_FLAG ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, CODE_NO, CODE, STATUS, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID, TEXT1, SORT_SEQ, USE_FLAG ) VALUES ( '100', 'KEPC', #CODE_NO#, #V_CODE#, 'C', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), 'DBA', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), 'DBA', #V_TEXT#, #V_SEQ#, '1' ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TEXT1 = #V_TEXT#, SORT_SEQ = #V_SEQ#, CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE CODE = #V_CODE# AND CODE_NO = #CODE_NO# AND HOUSE_CODE = '100' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KEPC' AND USE_FLAG = '1'

MERGE INTO KEPETIF01 A USING ( SELECT NVL(#V_CSTMR_BIZMN_REGST_NO#,'-') AS CSTMR_BIZMN_REGST_NO, NVL(#V_SPPLR_BIZMN_REGST_NO#,'-') AS SPPLR_BIZMN_REGST_NO, NVL(#V_DEPT_CD#,'-') AS DEPT_CD, NVL(#V_AMT_LIMT_CD#,'-') AS AMT_LIMT_CD, NVL(#V_PAY_CND_CD#,'-') AS PAY_CND_CD, NVL(#V_PAY_FORM_CD#,'-') AS PAY_FORM_CD, NVL(#V_CLSN_STRT_DAY#,'-') AS CLSN_STRT_DAY, NVL(#V_CLSN_FNSH_DAY#,'-') AS CLSN_FNSH_DAY, NVL(#V_USE_STRT_DATE#,'-') AS USE_STRT_DATE, NVL(#V_USE_FNSH_DATE#,'-') AS USE_FNSH_DATE, NVL(#V_ALANC_TYP_CD#,'-') AS ALANC_TYP_CD FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( CSTMR_BIZMN_REGST_NO, SPPLR_BIZMN_REGST_NO, DEPT_CD, AMT_LIMT_CD, PAY_CND_CD, PAY_FORM_CD, CLSN_STRT_DAY, CLSN_FNSH_DAY, USE_STRT_DATE, USE_FNSH_DATE, ALANC_TYP_CD, SITE_NM, CSTMR_NM, SPPLR_NM, DEPT_NM ) VALUES ( NVL(#V_CSTMR_BIZMN_REGST_NO#,'-'), NVL(TRIM(#V_SPPLR_BIZMN_REGST_NO#),'-'), NVL(#V_DEPT_CD#,'-'), NVL(#V_AMT_LIMT_CD#,'-'), NVL(#V_PAY_CND_CD#,'-'), NVL(#V_PAY_FORM_CD#,'-'), NVL(#V_CLSN_STRT_DAY#,'-'), NVL(#V_CLSN_FNSH_DAY#,'-'), NVL(#V_USE_STRT_DATE#,'-'), NVL(#V_USE_FNSH_DATE#,'-'), NVL(#V_ALANC_TYP_CD#,'-'), NVL(#V_SITE_NM#,'-'), NVL(#V_CSTMR_NM#,'-'), NVL(#V_SPPLR_NM#,'-'), NVL(#V_DEPT_NM#,'-') ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET SITE_NM = NVL(#V_SITE_NM#,'-'), CSTMR_NM = NVL(#V_CSTMR_NM#,'-'), SPPLR_NM = NVL(#V_SPPLR_NM#,'-'), DEPT_NM = NVL(#V_DEPT_NM#,'-') WHERE CSTMR_BIZMN_REGST_NO = NVL(#V_CSTMR_BIZMN_REGST_NO#,'-') AND SPPLR_BIZMN_REGST_NO = NVL(#V_SPPLR_BIZMN_REGST_NO#,'-') AND DEPT_CD = NVL(#V_DEPT_CD#,'-') AND AMT_LIMT_CD = NVL(#V_AMT_LIMT_CD#,'-') AND PAY_CND_CD = NVL(#V_PAY_CND_CD#,'-') AND PAY_FORM_CD = NVL(#V_PAY_FORM_CD#,'-') AND CLSN_STRT_DAY = NVL(#V_CLSN_STRT_DAY#,'-') AND CLSN_FNSH_DAY = NVL(#V_CLSN_FNSH_DAY#,'-') AND USE_STRT_DATE = NVL(#V_USE_STRT_DATE#,'-') AND USE_FNSH_DATE = NVL(#V_USE_FNSH_DATE#,'-') AND ALANC_TYP_CD = NVL(#V_ALANC_TYP_CD#,'-')

UPDATE KEPMDCP08 SET PAY_CND_CD = NVL(TRIM(#V_PAYMENT_TERM#), PAY_CND_CD), PAY_FORM_CD = NVL(TRIM(#V_PAYMENT_TYPE#), PAY_FORM_CD), LST_MDFY_DATM = SYSDATE, MDFYR_ID = 'FTP' WHERE SPPLR_ID IN ( SELECT CP04.SPPLR_ID FROM KEPMDCP01 CP01, KEPMDCP04 CP04 WHERE CP01.ALANC_ID = CP04.ALANC_ID AND CP01.BIZMN_REGST_NO = #V_PARTNER_ID# AND CP01.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND CP04.USE_CHK = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT CP05.SPPLR_ID FROM KEPMDCP01 CP01, KEPMDCP05 CP05 WHERE CP01.ALANC_ID = CP05.ALANC_ID AND CP01.BIZMN_REGST_NO = #V_PARTNER_ID# AND CP01.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND CP05.USE_CHK = 'Y' ) AND USE_CHK='Y'
